card.name: Comma after Severe in NSAID warnings
card.fires_on: The comma right after the word Severe at the start of a sentence about anaphylactic reactions to aspirin or other NSAIDs, in contraindication text.

modes.label: Severe, then comma
modes.description: A comma directly after a sentence-initial Severe, before a list of adjectives like sometimes fatal.
modes.example: History of asthma, urticaria, or other allergic-type reactions after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs. Severe<<,>> sometimes fatal, anaphylactic reactions

card.writes: It favors size and complexity words like large, huge and complex, and pushes down minor, mild and small.
card.plain: It marks the comma after "Severe" in a warning about serious allergic reactions to aspirin-type drugs.
